name: Isine Kettle
role: the late king's cupbearer; nurse of the forge ward
appearance: Small and grey, a scullion's forearms and a courtier's posture; her left palm wrapped over a coal-shaped burn.
voice: Clipped and formal, a servant's courtesy even when terrified ("If it please you, ser"); folds and refolds any cloth in her hands.
backstory: For thirty years Isine was King Ivoard's cupbearer and body-servant. She heard his last words, "Break it", and pried the Heartcoal from the crown with his own knife before fleeing to Okton. A Choir knife cut her at the pyre. She testified at the noon council that the king named no heir, and now nurses the burn-sick in the forge ward under Watch protection.
wants: To obey her king's last order, then to heal people; she would rather be a surgeon than a soldier.
fears: The Pyrewardens; dying on a cot before she can choose the Quenching.
secrets: She carries the burn at Stirring and has learned to bleed it off.
She wants the Quenching once she can stand a full day without shaking.
She knows Oselle's taster was bribed.
dm_only: Her slow poisoning was the king's own wine: she tasted from the same cups.
She is level 0: if the burn ran its full course it would kill her at the end.

relationships.name: Ivoard Hask
relationships.how: served him thirty years; heard his true last words

relationships.name: Okton
relationships.how: teaches her to bleed the heat; she ran to him

relationships.name: Chadickith
relationships.how: carried her to safety after the knifing

relationships.name: Tamius Coldwell

traits.name: Ward Nurse
traits.text: Brine washes and no bare-handed blood; she can stabilise a dying creature as an action without a check.
